key.name: sync-enabled
key.description: Whether GNOME Terminal colors follow the system light or dark color scheme. Turning this off restores the colors that were in use before the extension changed them.

key.name: apply-to-all-profiles
key.description: If true, every GNOME Terminal profile is kept in sync. If false, only the default profile is managed.

key.name: sync-palette
key.description: If true, the terminal's 16 ANSI palette colors are switched together with the background and text colors. Disable this to keep your custom palette untouched.

key.name: light-background
key.description: Background color used when the system prefers a light theme. The default matches GNOME Terminal's built-in "GNOME light" scheme.

key.name: light-foreground
key.description: Text color used when the system prefers a light theme. The default matches GNOME Terminal's built-in "GNOME light" scheme.

key.name: dark-background
key.description: Background color used when the system prefers a dark theme. The default matches GNOME Terminal's built-in "GNOME dark" scheme.

key.name: dark-foreground
key.description: Text color used when the system prefers a dark theme. The default matches GNOME Terminal's built-in "GNOME dark" scheme.

key.name: original-colors
key.description: Internal state. JSON object mapping profile UUIDs to the terminal colors that were in use before this extension changed them.

key.name: last-applied
key.description: Internal state. JSON object mapping profile UUIDs to the values this extension last wrote, so user changes can be detected when restoring.
